_read_me: One capability per file. Copy this file to capabilities/<id>.json (e.g. capabilities/receive-corn.json); the file name is the id. Each teammate owns at least one. scor_process: plan, source, make, deliver, return or enable. capacity_period: hour, day, week or month. evidence: a link to a real firm doing this at about this scale.
name: Receive and grade harvested corn
description: Trucks unload at our pit; each load is weighed, sampled for moisture and graded before it goes to a bin.
quality_promise: Moisture tested on every load; loads over 15.5% are dried before storage
